source_domain.species_or_population: adult human longitudinal EHR benchmark population
source_domain.site_or_dataset: synthetic reference to EHRSHOT/INSPECT/MedAlign-style benchmark infrastructure
source_domain.modality: structured longitudinal EHR events and clinical notes
source_domain.endpoint_type: benchmark task performance and workflow safety

target_domain.modality: veterinary records, imaging, lab values, owner-reported longitudinal observations
target_domain.endpoint_type: research organization and benchmark readiness, not diagnosis or treatment

translation_boundary.species_boundary: Human EHR evidence cannot be treated as animal physiology evidence without species-specific bridge validation.
translation_boundary.site_boundary: Human hospital and veterinary practice data have different collection incentives, missingness patterns, coding systems, and socioeconomic filters.
translation_boundary.modality_boundary: Clinical notes, veterinary notes, imaging, labs, owner reports, and wearable signals must be evaluated separately before fusion.
translation_boundary.workflow_boundary: Human clinical agent workflows do not automatically transfer to veterinary triage, owner communication, or practice constraints.
translation_boundary.endpoint_boundary: Benchmark performance cannot be promoted to cure, diagnosis, prognosis, or individual animal advice.
translation_boundary.consent_boundary: Reusable personal or animal memory requires explicit consent/reuse scope; public source maps remain synthetic.
translation_boundary.privacy_boundary: Rare species, breed, disease, owner-location, and longitudinal feature combinations can create re-identification risk.

bridge_evidence: Use benchmark design patterns only: task definitions, missingness labels, workflow reconstruction, and validation splits.
Require species-specific dataset validation before any animal-health inference is promoted.
Require endpoint-level separation between research infrastructure claims and clinical/veterinary claims.
blocked_inferences: Do not infer that a human EHR benchmark result applies to an animal patient.
Do not infer that veterinary AI market or infrastructure growth proves diagnostic accuracy.
Do not infer that mechanistic plausibility equals a cure claim.
Do not reuse private longitudinal memory as research evidence without consent and provenance.
missingness: No released Cornell veterinary benchmark dataset was inspected in this packet.
No species-specific validation cohort is attached.
No live consent ledger or memory store integration is present.
No human-subject or animal-subject data is included.
evaluation_criterion: A packet passes only if a curator can reconstruct what evidence is allowed to transfer, what is blocked, what bridge validation is missing, and what next test would reduce translation risk.
revision_reason: Add explicit cross-domain translation control after repeated frontier scouts produced gates for privacy, consent, perturbation, context drift, and evidence portability.
falsification_route: Reject or revise this gate if adversarial fixtures can still promote human-clinical evidence into animal-health or cure claims without bridge evidence, or if curator review shows no reduction in unsupported transfer.
